fusions.name: Five Stingers
fusions.desc: Flicks 5 stings at once, one from each finger, each dealing 4 poison damage with a 50% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on anything hit spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Parting Barb
fusions.desc: A sting that costs 5% of your maximum health, deals 9 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Waxworks
fusions.desc: Builds a hive that stands for 12 seconds and stings an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second, each sting with a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Worker's Tempo
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 10. The next ability you use spends them all: you move and attack 3% faster per stack (27% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
